article_content: According to a preliminary conclusion by a team of South Korean military and civilian investigators, the sinking of the 1,200-ton patrol ship Cheonan last month was caused by a close-range explosion, rather than a direct hit. The Yonhap news agency reported the investigators' findings on Sunday. A government official, as quoted by the news agency, stated, 'The Cheonan was affected by a powerful explosion that occurred beneath it at close range, instead of being directly struck by a torpedo or another underwater weapon.' This explanation aligns with the one investigators suggested shortly after the ship's stern was recovered 10 days prior. Defense Minister Kim Tae-young informed reporters that the final report is expected in one month. He indicated that the most probable cause of the sinking was a 'bubble jet' effect, resulting from an external explosion beneath the ship. The bubble jet effect happens when an explosion occurs under a vessel. The pressure change generates a large column of water that impacts the ship with considerable force. On Saturday, recovery teams located the body of a missing sailor within the ship's wreckage. The Cheonan sank on March 26 in the Yellow Sea, near the maritime border with North Korea. To date, 40 of the Cheonan's 104 crew members have been confirmed dead, and an additional six are presumed dead, although they remain listed as missing. Fifty-eight crew members were rescued before the ship sank. South Korea has not dismissed the possibility of North Korean involvement. However, Seoul has refrained from directly accusing North Korea, which has denied any responsibility. The families of the deceased sailors commenced a five-day mourning period on Sunday. The South Korean navy will conduct a funeral ceremony at a naval command in Pyeongtaek, approximately 70 kilometers (43 miles) south of Seoul, on Thursday. The navy has also decided to posthumously promote the fallen seamen by one rank and award them military honors in recognition of their patriotism.

Agencja prasowa Yonhap poinformowała o ustaleniach śledczych w niedzielę. Urzędnik rządowy, cytowany przez agencję prasową, oświadczył: 'Na okręt Cheonan wpłynął silny wybuch, który nastąpił pod jego dnem z bliskiej odległości, a nie bezpośrednie trafienie torpedą lub inną bronią podwodną.' Wyjaśnienie to jest zgodne z tym, co śledczy sugerowali wkrótce po wydobyciu rufy okrętu 10 dni wcześniej. Minister obrony Kim Tae-young poinformował dziennikarzy, że ostateczny raport spodziewany jest za miesiąc. Wskazał, że najbardziej prawdopodobną przyczyną zatonięcia był efekt 'bąbla powietrznego', wywołany zewnętrznym wybuchem pod okrętem. Efekt bąbla powietrznego występuje, gdy pod okrętem dochodzi do wybuchu. Gwałtowna zmiana ciśnienia generuje kolumnę wody, która uderza w okręt z ogromną siłą. W sobotę ekipy poszukiwawcze odnalazły ciało zaginionego marynarza we wraku okrętu. Okręt Cheonan zatonął 26 marca na Morzu Żółtym, w pobliżu granicy morskiej z Koreą Północną. Do tej pory potwierdzono śmierć 40 ze 104 członków załogi Cheonana, a kolejnych sześciu uznaje się za zmarłych, choć nadal figurują na liście zaginionych. Pięćdziesięciu ośmiu członków załogi uratowano przed zatonięciem okrętu. Korea Południowa nie wyklucza zaangażowania Korei Północnej. Jednak Seul powstrzymuje się od bezpośrednich oskarżeń wobec Korei Północnej, która zaprzecza jakiejkolwiek odpowiedzialności. Rodziny zmarłych marynarzy rozpoczęły w niedzielę pięciodniową żałobę. Uroczystości pogrzebowe odbędą się w czwartek w bazie marynarki w Pyeongtaek, około 70 kilometrów (43 mile) na południe od Seulu. Marynarka Wojenna podjęła decyzję o pośmiertnym awansowaniu poległych marynarzy o jeden stopień i przyznaniu im wojskowych odznaczeń w uznaniu ich patriotyzmu.

article_content: The Bingham Canyon Mine in Utah experienced the largest landslide ever recorded in North America, an event that shifted approximately 165 million tons of earth. This natural occurrence significantly reduced mining production by half following the incident on April 10. Fortunately, despite the scale of the disaster, no injuries were reported as operators swiftly evacuated all personnel and equipment before the massive slide swept through the canyon. Originating from the mine's northeastern section, the landslide cascaded down approximately six-tenths of a mile to the very bottom of the mine. Kennecott Copper Corp., the London-based company operating the mine, reported the enormous scale of the earth displacement. While refined copper shipments continued as usual through April, May deliveries were expected to decrease, and future shipments were uncertain. Although limited mining operations resumed in late April, Kennecott sought to mitigate costs by offering an early retirement package to 270 employees aged 50 or older. This package included a $20,000 bonus in addition to standard pension and health insurance benefits. Union officials indicated that about one-third of these eligible workers were considering accepting the offer, with a decision deadline of the upcoming Saturday. Before the landslide, the company employed 2,100 individuals and had been exploring cost-cutting measures, including potential layoffs. Jeff Moore, a geological engineer from the University of Utah, emphasized the unprecedented magnitude of the landslide, comparing its volume to filling 21 Great Pyramids of Giza or covering New York City's Central Park with 65 feet of debris. Cleanup efforts are expected to be substantial, with an estimated 150 million tons of waste requiring removal, nearly two-thirds of the mine's annual material movement. The Bingham Canyon Mine has been in operation for over a century. The early retirement offer to older workers aimed to alleviate financial strain following the production slowdown caused by the April landslide.
translated_content: Kopalnia Bingham Canyon w Utah doświadczyła największego osuwiska ziemi w historii Ameryki Północnej, w wyniku którego przesunęło się około 165 milionów ton ziemi. To naturalne zdarzenie znacząco zmniejszyło produkcję górniczą o połowę po incydencie, który miał miejsce 10 kwietnia. Na szczęście, pomimo skali katastrofy, nie odnotowano żadnych obrażeń, ponieważ operatorzy sprawnie ewakuowali cały personel i sprzęt, zanim potężne osuwisko przetoczyło się przez kanion. Osuwisko, które rozpoczęło się w północno-wschodniej części kopalni, spadło z wysokości około sześciu dziesiątych mili na samo dno kopalni. Kennecott Copper Corp., londyńska firma prowadząca kopalnię, poinformowała o ogromnej skali przemieszczenia ziemi. Podczas gdy dostawy rafinowanej miedzi były kontynuowane normalnie w kwietniu, oczekiwano, że dostawy majowe zmniejszą się, a przyszłe dostawy stały pod znakiem zapytania. Chociaż pod koniec kwietnia wznowiono ograniczone operacje wydobywcze, Kennecott starał się zminimalizować koszty, oferując pakiet wcześniejszych emerytur 270 pracownikom w wieku 50 lat lub starszym. Pakiet ten obejmował premię w wysokości 20 000 dolarów oprócz standardowej emerytury i świadczeń zdrowotnych. Przedstawiciele związków zawodowych wskazali, że około jedna trzecia uprawnionych pracowników rozważała przyjęcie oferty, a termin podjęcia decyzji upływał w najbliższą sobotę. Przed osuwiskiem firma zatrudniała 2100 osób i rozważała środki redukcji kosztów, w tym potencjalne zwolnienia. Jeff Moore, inżynier geolog z University of Utah, podkreślił bezprecedensową skalę osuwiska, porównując jego objętość do wypełnienia 21 piramid Cheopsa lub pokrycia nowojorskiego Central Parku warstwą gruzu o grubości 20 metrów. Oczekuje się, że prace porządkowe będą znaczące, z szacowaną ilością 150 milionów ton odpadów do usunięcia, co stanowi prawie dwie trzecie rocznego wydobycia kopalni. Kopalnia Bingham Canyon działa od ponad wieku. Oferta wcześniejszych emerytur dla starszych pracowników miała na celu zmniejszenie obciążenia finansowego po spowolnieniu produkcji spowodowanym kwietniowym osuwiskiem.

article_content: During an overnight American Airlines flight to Chile, New York Mets pitcher LaTroy Hawkins stepped in to assist in restraining a disruptive passenger. Hawkins shared on his Instagram account that he aided a flight attendant who was struggling with a passenger displeased with his seating arrangement. The disturbance took place on flight 945 traveling from Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport to Santiago on a Sunday. According to a text message sent to The New York Daily News, Hawkins stated that he and others had to restrain a man who was agitated about not being able to occupy a vacant seat in business class. The passenger and the flight attendant engaged in a physical altercation, ultimately falling into Hawkins' lap. The flight attendant then requested assistance. Due to the passenger's disruptive behavior, the aircraft made an unplanned landing in Lima, Peru, where the individual was removed from the flight and placed in the custody of local law enforcement. Hawkins, whose height of 6ft 5in would have been a welcome presence for the flight attendant, mentioned on Instagram that he and another 'stud' had to subdue a passenger during their flight from Dallas to Santiago, Chile. Following an emergency landing in Peru, they escorted the passenger off the plane, describing it as a long night with a 'crazy' passenger. An American Airlines representative verified that flight 945 diverted its course because of a problematic passenger. The spokesman told ESPN that such situations of noncompliance and unruly behavior occasionally occur. To ensure the safety of everyone on board, removing the individual from the plane is the easiest solution. The airline did just that, handing the passenger over to local authorities before resuming the flight to its original destination. According to ESPN, Hawkins was en route to Chile with his friends Rodney Carter and Leonard Whittenberg for a dove hunting trip. When he isn't assisting as an 'air marshall,' LaTroy Hawkins is a baseball player for the New York Mets.

article_content: Many have experienced the monotony of school, watching the clock and struggling to stay awake. But few have been whisked away from class by Real Madrid to travel to Norway and sit on the bench for a Champions League match against Rosenborg. Iker Casillas, at 16, was pulled from a technical drawing lesson in 1997 to join the Real Madrid squad. In the game against Liverpool, he surpassed all others with his 144th appearance in the competition. Having won it three times over a 15-year career with the first team, he dismisses any suggestion that his time at the top is nearing its end. Casillas, who has secured three Champions League titles during his tenure with Real Madrid, stated to Sportsmail, 'I believe I can continue playing until I reach 40.' He clarifies that this isn't about playing in a less challenging environment, adding, 'I began here, and I intend to conclude my career here,' effectively silencing rumors of his departure after this season. Despite being viewed negatively by some fans in recent years, labeled (though he disputes this) as the dressing-room mole during Jose Mourinho's turbulent period at Real Madrid, others within the club still regard him as a successful local player. 'They took me from school because Bodo Illgner and Santi Cañizares were injured, requiring me as a reserve keeper,' he recalls of that day in November 1997. 'I was brought to the headmaster—a devoted Madrid fan—and soon found myself on a school minibus heading home, where my mother was frantically preparing my luggage. My classmates were unaware of my sudden departure, and there were no mobile phones or Twitter to inform them.' Although Cañizares recovered, leaving Iker as Real's third-choice keeper, coach Jupp Heynckes still instructed him to dress and take his place on the bench. 'I recognized everyone, but no one recognized me,' he says of his esteemed teammates. 'I sat at the same table before the match as Cañizares and Fernando Morientes, but remained silent.' Casillas admits he hasn’t calculated the precise number of Champions League matches he anticipates playing. 'The immediate goal is to secure consecutive victories,' he states. 'If we exhibit the same dedication as last year, why not? Our first objective is to advance to the knockout stages.' While a victory over Liverpool would ensure this, he points out a significant obstacle: 'Liverpool needs to win,' he says. 'English teams are relentlessly competitive. Liverpool will arrive at a stadium where they have previously won, prepared to give their utmost.' He regards Steven Gerrard, Liverpool's one-club player, as 'the essence of Liverpool'. 'These are the players who embody the club's identity,' he remarks. 'Like Carles Puyol and Xavi at Barcelona, and Totti at Roma—players with a genuine connection to the supporters. If you are content and performing well at a major club, there is no reason to consider leaving.' Having sought Gerrard for a shirt exchange at Anfield, Casillas intends to approach Mario Balotelli, although not at halftime. 'In Spain, swapping shirts at halftime is acceptable,' he says, referencing Balotelli’s recent controversy. Casillas’s Madrid career has been marked by both challenges and triumphs. Mourinho's decision to bench him in favor of Diego Lopez, whom he deemed a superior keeper, was offset by Carlo Ancelotti’s solution to play Lopez in league matches and Casillas in the Spanish Cup and Champions League. This arrangement resulted in Casillas winning the two tournaments he participated in, while Madrid finished third in the league. Casillas has claimed five league titles, three Champions Leagues, a World Cup, and two European Championships. He recalls that winning the Champions League in Lisbon last May felt even more significant than winning the World Cup, attributing this to the immediate relief after his mistake, which allowed Atletico Madrid to score the initial goal, became irrelevant. 'During that moment, I stood on the goal-line, contemplating the situation and wanting to leave my penalty area to attempt an equaliser, yet knowing I couldn't. Thus, you can imagine my emotions when Sergio Ramos scored the header.' 'One of football's unfortunate aspects is the tendency to remember only recent events. My error enabled Atletico to take the lead. Winning a trophy encompasses the entire season, the struggle to reach the final, and my performance throughout the competition had been strong.' 'However, we were in control of the game, and my lapse nearly cost us the match. I recall observing the stadium filled with supporters in white shirts and feeling awful. Fortunately, in the final play, we secured the draw, and I believe extra time demonstrated our superiority.' Casillas is both captain of Real Madrid and Spain, having made 158 appearances for his nation. 'Sergio’s goal spared me from considerable criticism. I’m confident numerous papers had to revise their headlines in that final minute.' Maintaining success at a club such as Real Madrid for an extended period requires considerable resilience. Casillas has rebounded this season, displaying excellent form for his club. Although his mistake against Slovakia led to David de Gea, whom he describes as 'both the present and future of Spanish football,' replacing him in the national side, he intends to continue playing with the Spain team until at least Euro 2016. At Real, the obsession with 'la decima' has been superseded by the pursuit of 'la undecima' (the 11th title). 'At a club of this magnitude, winning the European Cup secures approximately one month of respite,' he notes. 'With a team as strong as ours, we must strive to win it again. There is no room for complacency. Joining this club provides a rapid lesson in impatience.' The pursuit of the eleventh title is the Real Madrid way.
translated_content: Wielu z nas doświadczyło szkolnej monotonii, wpatrując się w zegar i walcząc ze znużeniem. Niewielu jednak zostało wyciągniętych z lekcji przez Real Madryt, by polecieć do Norwegii i zasiąść na ławce rezerwowych podczas meczu Ligi Mistrzów przeciwko Rosenborgowi. Iker Casillas, mając 16 lat, został wyciągnięty z lekcji rysunku technicznego w 1997 roku, aby dołączyć do składu Realu Madryt. W meczu przeciwko Liverpoolowi ustanowił rekord, zaliczając swój 144. występ w tych rozgrywkach. Po trzykrotnym triumfie w Lidze Mistrzów w ciągu 15 lat kariery w pierwszej drużynie, odrzuca sugestie, że jego czas na szczycie dobiega końca. Casillas, który zdobył trzy tytuły Ligi Mistrzów podczas swojej kariery w Realu Madryt, powiedział dla Sportsmail: 'Wierzę, że mogę grać do 40. roku życia'. Wyjaśnia, że nie chodzi o występy w mniej wymagającym otoczeniu, dodając: 'Zacząłem tutaj i zamierzam tutaj zakończyć karierę', uciszając tym samym plotki o jego odejściu po tym sezonie. Pomimo negatywnego odbioru przez niektórych fanów w ostatnich latach, którzy oskarżali go (czemu on zaprzecza) o bycie 'kretem' w szatni podczas burzliwych rządów Jose Mourinho w Realu Madryt, inni w klubie nadal widzą w nim odnoszącego sukcesy wychowanka. 'Wyciągnęli mnie ze szkoły, ponieważ Bodo Illgner i Santi Cañizares byli kontuzjowani. Potrzebowali mnie jako rezerwowego bramkarza' - wspomina tamten dzień z listopada 1997 roku. 'Zaprowadzono mnie do dyrektora – zagorzałego fana Realu Madryt – i wkrótce znalazłem się w szkolnym busie jadącym do domu, gdzie moja mama gorączkowo pakowała mi torbę. Moi koledzy z klasy nie wiedzieli, dlaczego nagle wyszedłem, a nie było wtedy telefonów komórkowych ani Twittera, żeby ich o tym poinformować.' Mimo że Cañizares wyzdrowiał, a Iker był trzecim bramkarzem Realu, trener Jupp Heynckes i tak kazał mu się przebrać i usiąść na ławce. 'Rozpoznawałem wszystkich, ale nikt mnie nie znał' - mówi o swoich wybitnych kolegach z drużyny. 'Siedziałem przed meczem przy tym samym stole co Cañizares i Fernando Morientes, ale nie odzywałem się.' Casillas przyznaje, że nie obliczył, ile meczów w Lidze Mistrzów jeszcze zagra. 'Najbliższy cel to wygrać Ligę Mistrzów dwa razy z rzędu' - stwierdza. 'Jeśli pokażemy takie samo zaangażowanie jak w zeszłym roku, to dlaczego nie? Najpierw jednak musimy awansować do fazy pucharowej.' Choć zwycięstwo nad Liverpoolem by to zapewniło, wskazuje na istotną przeszkodę: 'Liverpool musi wygrać' - mówi. 'Angielskie drużyny nigdy się nie poddają. Liverpool przyjedzie na stadion, na którym już wygrywał, i da z siebie wszystko.' Uważa Stevena Gerrarda, zawodnika związanego z Liverpoolem przez całą karierę, za 'kwintesencję Liverpoolu'. 'To są zawodnicy, którzy dają klubowi tożsamość' - zauważa. 'Tak jak Carles Puyol i Xavi w Barcelonie, czy Totti w Romie – piłkarze autentycznie związani z kibicami. Jeśli jesteś szczęśliwy i dobrze grasz w wielkim klubie, nie ma powodu, żeby gdziekolwiek odchodzić.' Po tym, jak poprosił Gerrarda o wymianę koszulek na Anfield, Casillas zamierza poprosić o nią Mario Balotellego, choć nie w przerwie meczu. 'W Hiszpanii wymiana koszulek w przerwie meczu jest dopuszczalna' - mówi, nawiązując do niedawnej sytuacji z Balotellim. Kariera Casillasa w Madrycie była pełna wyzwań i triumfów. Decyzja Mourinho o posadzeniu go na ławce na rzecz Diego Lopeza, którego uważał za lepszego bramkarza, została zrekompensowana przez Carlo Ancelottiego, który wystawiał Lopeza w lidze, a Casillasa w Pucharze Króla i Lidze Mistrzów. W efekcie Casillas wygrał te dwa turnieje, w których brał udział, a Real zajął trzecie miejsce w lidze. Casillas zdobył pięć tytułów mistrza Hiszpanii, trzy Ligi Mistrzów, Puchar Świata i dwa Mistrzostwa Europy. Wspomina, że wygrana w Lidze Mistrzów w Lizbonie w maju ubiegłego roku wydawała się jeszcze ważniejsza niż zdobycie Pucharu Świata. Tłumaczy to natychmiastową ulgą po swoim błędzie, który pozwolił Atletico Madryt na zdobycie pierwszej bramki, ale ostatecznie nie miał znaczenia. 'W tamtym momencie stałem na linii bramkowej, rozmyślając o sytuacji i chciałem wyjść z pola karnego, żeby spróbować wyrównać, ale wiedziałem, że nie mogę. Możecie więc sobie wyobrazić, co poczułem, kiedy Sergio Ramos strzelił gola głową!' 'Jednym z smutnych aspektów piłki nożnej jest to, że ludzie pamiętają tylko o ostatnich wydarzeniach. Mój błąd pozwolił Atletico wyjść na prowadzenie. Zdobycie trofeum to efekt całego sezonu, walki o dojście do finału, a moja gra w tych rozgrywkach była bardzo dobra.' 'Jednak kontrolowaliśmy grę, a mój błąd omal nie kosztował nas porażki. Pamiętam, jak patrzyłem na stadion wypełniony kibicami w białych koszulkach i czułem się okropnie. Na szczęście w ostatniej akcji doprowadziliśmy do remisu i uważam, że dogrywka pokazała, jak bardzo byliśmy lepsi.' Casillas jest kapitanem Realu Madryt i reprezentacji Hiszpanii. Wystąpił w 158 meczach w barwach narodowych. 'Gol Sergio uchronił mnie przed sporą krytyką. Jestem pewien, że wiele gazet musiało zmienić nagłówki w ostatniej minucie.' Utrzymanie się na szczycie w klubie takim jak Real Madryt przez tak długi czas wymaga ogromnej odporności. Casillas odzyskał formę w tym sezonie, prezentując doskonałą dyspozycję. Choć błąd w meczu ze Słowacją otworzył drogę Davidowi de Gei, którego określa jako 'zarówno teraźniejszość, jak i przyszłość hiszpańskiej piłki', w reprezentacji, on zamierza grać w niej przynajmniej do Euro 2016. W Realu obsesja na punkcie 'la decima' została zastąpiona dążeniem do 'la undecima' (11. tytułu). 'W klubie tej rangi wygranie Ligi Mistrzów daje ci około miesiąca spokoju' - zauważa. 'Mając tak dobry zespół, musimy spróbować wygrać ją ponownie. Nie ma miejsca na zadowalanie się tym, co już osiągnęliśmy. Dołączenie do tego klubu to przyspieszony kurs niecierpliwości.' Pogoń za jedenastym tytułem to istota Realu Madryt.

article_content: By Kerry Mcdermott PUBLISHED: 05:33 EST, March 22, 2013 | UPDATED: 05:55 EST, March 22, 2013 A photograph of a uniformed police officer apparently asleep on the job has been posted on Facebook. Police chiefs in Greater Manchester have launched an investigation after the embarrassing picture was discovered on the site. It shows the Salford-based PC, 26, slumped on a sofa in full uniform with his eyes closed. It is understood to have been taken following an incident where officers were called out in the city. Sleeping policeman: The photograph, which shows the Salford-based officer in full uniform apparently asleep, was posted on Facebook. The caption on the picture names the PC and includes 'expert scene management' as his middle name. Underneath the photograph, a colleague commented: 'The picture doesn’t quite capture the snoring'. Greater Manchester Police's professional standards branch is investigating the incident. The slumbering Salford officer is seen on a black leather sofa, surrounded by sheets of paper and a Primark shopping bag. The officer’s name has not been disclosed due to concerns about potential reprisals. The photograph, believed to have been taken several weeks ago, had been viewed by 29 people before it was removed from Facebook after GMP was alerted. The officer’s Facebook page has since been taken down. A force spokesman stated: 'Greater Manchester Police’s Professional Standards Branch is making inquiries to establish the full circumstances relating to when and where this photograph was taken. These inquiries are ongoing.' Embarrassing: Greater Manchester Police is investigating after the force was alerted to the photograph. Ian Hanson, chairman of GMP Federation, said: 'Whilst it would not be appropriate to comment on this particular incident as it is under internal investigation, I would point out that what is portrayed briefly in a picture is not necessarily the full story.' The image surfaced almost exactly one year after a photo was published of two GMP specialist armed officers fooling around with a shotgun on the bonnet of a Land Rover Defender armored vehicle. Following an inquiry by GMP’s Professional Standards branch, the officers and the weapons instructor who took the image were moved from the Tactical Firearms Unit to other divisions. The internal investigation was launched after the picture was found on a computer during an unrelated raid on another officer’s home.

article_content: Fiona Woolf, the newly appointed head of the inquiry into historic sex abuse, faces increasing scrutiny due to her long-standing connections with Leon Brittan, who is accused of covering up allegations during his tenure as Home Secretary. Concerns are mounting as further evidence emerges of Woolf's ties to a central figure in the scandal. These connections span at least a decade. Records show that Woolf and Brittan's wife, Diana, both served at the same magistrates’ court for three years. Woolf also held a senior position at the Law Society when it hosted a conference featuring Lord Brittan as a speaker. Her absence from the initial inquiry meeting, due to a business trip to Africa in her capacity as Lord Mayor of London, has drawn criticism. A planned Commons debate on Woolf's role was blocked by William Hague, a former protege of Lord Brittan. Campaigners have criticized Woolf for allegedly treating the investigation with disregard, urging her and the Home Office to disclose the extent of her relationship with Lord Brittan. Despite calls from Parliament, Woolf has declined to confirm whether she declared potential conflicts of interest. These revelations follow reports that Woolf, 66, has resided on the same street as the Brittans since 2005, serves on a City conference board with the former Minister, donated £50 to his wife's charity run, and participates as a judge in a business award alongside her. Lord Brittan's involvement stems from his handling of hundreds of child abuse files that the Home Office has acknowledged were lost or destroyed. Brittan claims he passed a now-missing dossier from 1983 to officials. Labour MP Simon Danczuk, who previously exposed Cyril Smith, has called for transparency from both the Home Office and Fiona Woolf regarding her relationship with the Brittans, suggesting that any lack of cooperation will fuel suspicions, particularly among victims. Danczuk expressed his unease in the Commons but was overruled by William Hague, who had succeeded Lord Brittan as MP for Richmond in North Yorkshire in 1989 and previously worked as his speechwriter. Danczuk believes Hague's decision will raise eyebrows. Peter Saunders, of the National Association for People Abused in Childhood, believes that the links between Woolf and the Brittans will severely damage the inquiry's credibility. The Judicial Office confirmed Woolf's tenure at City of London Magistrates’ Court overlapped with Lady Brittan's chairmanship. While Woolf became a Justice of the Peace in 2007, Lady Brittan chaired the bench until 2010. Officials cited logistical challenges in determining if they collaborated on specific cases. Additionally, records indicate that Leon Brittan delivered the opening address at a 2005 Law Society conference during Woolf's vice-presidency. Woolf was questioned about her connections to the Brittans but declined to comment. She was in Uganda when the inquiry held its first meeting, described by the Home Office as an 'informal discussion... in accordance with her directions'. The Home Office has not disclosed whether Woolf declared her links to the Brittans, but stated that she is an 'exceptional and highly qualified candidate for this demanding role.'

Rosną obawy w miarę pojawiania się dalszych dowodów na powiązania Woolf z centralną postacią w skandalu. Te powiązania trwają co najmniej dekadę. Zapisy wskazują, że Woolf i żona Brittana, Diana, pracowały w tym samym sądzie grodzkim przez trzy lata. Woolf zajmowała również wysokie stanowisko w Towarzystwie Prawniczym, kiedy organizowało ono konferencję z udziałem Lorda Brittana jako prelegenta. Jej nieobecność na pierwszym posiedzeniu komisji śledczej, spowodowana podróżą służbową do Afryki w charakterze Lorda Mer Londynu, spotkała się z krytyką. Planowana debata w Izbie Gmin na temat roli Woolf została zablokowana przez Williama Hague'a, byłego protegowanego Lorda Brittana. Krytycy zarzucają Woolf lekceważące traktowanie śledztwa, wzywając ją i Ministerstwo Spraw Wewnętrznych do ujawnienia zakresu jej relacji z Lordem Brittanem. Pomimo wezwań ze strony Parlamentu, Woolf nie potwierdziła, czy zgłosiła potencjalne konflikty interesów. Te rewelacje następują po doniesieniach, że Woolf, 66 lat, mieszka na tej samej ulicy co Brittanowie od 2005 roku, zasiada w zarządzie konferencji miejskiej z byłym ministrem, przekazała 50 funtów na bieg charytatywny jego żony i uczestniczy jako sędzia w konkursie biznesowym u jej boku. Zaangażowanie Lorda Brittana wynika z jego postępowania w sprawie setek akt dotyczących wykorzystywania dzieci, które Ministerstwo Spraw Wewnętrznych uznało za zagubione lub zniszczone. Brittan twierdzi, że przekazał urzędnikom zaginione akta z 1983 roku. Poseł Partii Pracy Simon Danczuk, który wcześniej zdemaskował Cyrila Smitha, wezwał zarówno Ministerstwo Spraw Wewnętrznych, jak i Fionę Woolf do przejrzystości w kwestii jej relacji z Brittanami, sugerując, że brak współpracy wzbudzi podejrzenia, szczególnie wśród ofiar. Danczuk wyraził swoje zaniepokojenie w Izbie Gmin, ale został odrzucony przez Williama Hague'a, który zastąpił Lorda Brittana jako poseł okręgu Richmond w North Yorkshire w 1989 roku i wcześniej pracował jako jego autor przemówień. Danczuk uważa, że decyzja Hague'a wzbudzi zdziwienie. Peter Saunders z Krajowego Stowarzyszenia Osób Wykorzystywanych w Dzieciństwie uważa, że powiązania między Woolf a Brittanami poważnie zaszkodzą wiarygodności śledztwa. Biuro Sądownictwa potwierdziło, że kadencja Woolf w Sądzie Grodzkim City of London pokrywała się z przewodnictwem Lady Brittan. Podczas gdy Woolf została sędzią pokoju w 2007 roku, Lady Brittan przewodniczyła ławie do 2010 roku. Urzędnicy powołali się na trudności logistyczne w ustaleniu, czy współpracowali przy konkretnych sprawach. Dodatkowo, zapisy wskazują, że Leon Brittan wygłosił przemówienie otwierające na konferencji Towarzystwa Prawniczego w 2005 roku, podczas gdy Woolf była jego wiceprezesem. Woolf była pytana o swoje powiązania z Brittanami, ale odmówiła komentarza. Przebywała w Ugandzie, kiedy komisja śledcza odbyła swoje pierwsze posiedzenie, które Ministerstwo Spraw Wewnętrznych określiło jako 'nieformalną dyskusję... zgodnie z jej wytycznymi'. Ministerstwo Spraw Wewnętrznych nie ujawniło, czy Woolf zgłosiła swoje powiązania z Brittanami, ale stwierdziło, że jest 'wyjątkową i wysoko wykwalifikowaną kandydatką na to wymagające stanowisko'.

article_content: Boxer Floyd Mayweather Jr. was booked into the Clark County Detention Center in Nevada on Friday to begin serving a 90-day sentence. The sentence stems from a domestic violence conviction last year, according to police. The high-profile athlete will be held in isolation from the facility's approximately 3,000 other inmates. "He will receive one hour of free time per day by himself," the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department stated in a news release. The undefeated boxer was convicted after police reported he punched the mother of his children at his residence. Mayweather's jail reporting date had been previously delayed by a Nevada judge to allow him to compete against Miguel Cotto, the WBA super-welterweight champion. Mayweather, nicknamed "Money," won a unanimous decision in the Las Vegas fight, earning $32 million. Originally from Michigan, Mayweather has secured seven titles across various weight classes since turning professional in 1996. A photo published on his website on Thursday showed Mayweather receiving a pedicure while seated on a footstool and leaning against a pillow.

"Będzie miał godzinę czasu wolnego dziennie, spędzoną w samotności," podała policja metropolitalna Las Vegas w komunikacie prasowym. article_content: Health campaigners are calling for a comprehensive inquiry into the Welsh NHS, which is under Labour control. The Daily Mail has revealed distressing cases of patients dying while on waiting lists or being compelled to relocate to England for essential treatment. Over the coming days, this investigation will uncover severe neglect and a political establishment that appears to be in denial. Despite Labour's challenging performance in Wales, Ed Miliband intended to prioritize the NHS in Labour's upcoming election campaign next May. However, families who have experienced hardship within Welsh hospitals argue that the situation surpasses the Mid Staffordshire scandal. The British Medical Association, the Conservatives, Plaid Cymru, Labour MP Ann Clwyd, and a recent survey indicating that seven out of ten voters agree, are all advocating for an independent inquiry. The Mail's investigation promises to reveal further details. Recently, a scandal emerged at Glan Clwyd Hospital in Rhyl, North Wales, involving police investigations into allegations that staff used furniture to restrain dementia patients. The British Medical Association previously warned of an 'imminent meltdown' in the Welsh NHS and urged an independent investigation. Last year, the College of Emergency Medicine alerted the Welsh health minister to potential risks to patients in casualty units. Sir Bruce Keogh of NHS England also communicated concerns to his Welsh counterpart in November, suggesting that six hospitals should be examined due to 'persistently high' mortality rates. A survey commissioned by the Welsh Conservatives indicated that one-third of individuals with recent hospital experiences encountered issues, and nearly one in five felt their concerns were dismissed. The survey further revealed that 71% support an independent inquiry into the NHS, and 60% believe the health service has declined in the last five years. Respondents included a retired nurse who voiced concerns that senior managers were hesitant to address inadequate practices. An orthopaedic consultant described Wales's NHS as 'on the verge of becoming a third-world health service'. The research involved 3,295 responses to an online survey and mailings to 5,000 randomly selected households. Gareth Williams, who has actively campaigned to expose shortcomings at the Abertawe Bro Morgannwg University health board following his mother Lilian's neglect in the hospital, stated, 'I believe the indifference of government ministers in Cardiff is callous. They can no longer maintain that concerns are isolated to ABMU or Wales. We are still in denial in Wales, similar to England when the Mid Staffs scandal became public.' Hundreds of patients suffered due to neglect at Stafford Hospital. Mr. Williams mentioned that seven whistleblower nurses have contacted him and fellow campaigners. Miss Clwyd recounted her husband's death in a manner akin to that of a 'battery hen' at University Hospital Wales in October 2012. She emphasized high mortality rates at certain Welsh hospitals and extended wait times for diagnostic procedures. Regarding the situation, a spokesman for the Cardiff administration stated: 'The vast majority of people in Wales receive excellent care from our NHS, which is more open, transparent, and subjected to a higher level of scrutiny than any other health service in the UK. If issues are identified, we act promptly to resolve them.' A spokesman for the ABMU health board added: 'The vast majority of patients receive good quality care – our complaints rate over the past year was 0.15 per cent – but we recognize that any instance of inadequate care is unacceptable, and we are committed to rectifying the situation.'

Brytyjskie Stowarzyszenie Lekarskie (British Medical Association), Konserwatyści, Plaid Cymru, posłanka Partii Pracy Ann Clwyd oraz niedawne badanie wskazujące, że siedmiu na dziesięciu wyborców się z tym zgadza, wszyscy opowiadają się za niezależnym dochodzeniem. Badanie zlecone przez Walijskich Konserwatystów wykazało, że jedna trzecia osób z niedawnymi doświadczeniami szpitalnymi napotkała problemy, a prawie jedna na pięć uważała, że ich obawy zostały zignorowane. Badanie ujawniło również, że 71% popiera niezależne dochodzenie w sprawie NHS, a 60% uważa, że służba zdrowia pogorszyła się w ciągu ostatnich pięciu lat. Wśród respondentów znalazła się emerytowana pielęgniarka, która wyraziła obawy, że starsi menedżerowie wahają się przed zajęciem się nieprawidłowościami. Konsultant ortopeda opisał walijską NHS jako 'na skraju stania się służbą zdrowia na poziomie krajów trzeciego świata'. Badanie objęło 3295 odpowiedzi na ankietę online oraz wysyłki do 5000 losowo wybranych gospodarstw domowych. Nie mogą już utrzymywać, że obawy ograniczają się do ABMU lub Walii. W Walii nadal jesteśmy w fazie zaprzeczania, podobnie jak Anglia, kiedy wybuchł skandal w Mid Staffs'. Setki pacjentów ucierpiało z powodu zaniedbań w szpitalu Stafford. Pan Williams wspomniał, że skontaktowało się z nim i jego współpracownikami siedem pielęgniarek-sygnalistek. Pani Clwyd opowiedziała, jak jej mąż zmarł w sposób przypominający 'kurę bateryjną' w University Hospital Wales w październiku 2012 roku. Podkreśliła wysokie wskaźniki śmiertelności w niektórych walijskich szpitalach i długi czas oczekiwania na badania diagnostyczne. Odnosząc się do sytuacji, rzecznik administracji Cardiff stwierdził: 'Zdecydowana większość mieszkańców Walii otrzymuje doskonałą opiekę w naszej NHS, która jest bardziej otwarta, przejrzysta i podlega większej kontroli niż jakakolwiek inna służba zdrowia w Wielkiej Brytanii. W przypadku zidentyfikowania problemów, działamy szybko, aby je rozwiązać'. Rzecznik zarządu zdrowia ABMU dodał: 'Zdecydowana większość pacjentów otrzymuje opiekę dobrej jakości – nasz wskaźnik skarg w ciągu ostatniego roku wyniósł 0,15 procent – ale zdajemy sobie sprawę, że jakakolwiek niewłaściwa opieka jest niedopuszczalna i jesteśmy zobowiązani do naprawy sytuacji'.

article_content: Parts of Wheeler, Texas, were evacuated Saturday due to strong, shifting winds that fueled wildfires, officials said. Wildfires in the Texas panhandle are being intensified by sustained winds of approximately 40 mph. A fire had destroyed two homes and one business, engulfing about 8,000 acres by Saturday night, according to Lewis Kearney, a spokesman for Texas emergency services. An additional 12 homes were damaged, and 300 homes and 60 businesses were threatened, state emergency officials reported. The strong winds—sustained at about 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph—hindered helicopter and vehicle firefighting efforts, Kearney said. Adding to the challenge, three other smaller fires, each about 100 acres, elsewhere in the state strained emergency resources. No injuries were immediately reported in the Wheeler fire. Approximately 200 residents of the town of about 1,400 people on the eastern edge of the Texas panhandle were evacuated Saturday, officials stated. The fire reportedly began around 4 p.m. ET Saturday, according to the state report.

article_content: Washington (CNN) - The family of a man who fought alongside U.S. troops in Vietnam has been told that their relative will not be allowed burial at Arlington National Cemetery. Major General Vang Pao led thousands of Hmong soldiers who fought alongside the United States against the North Vietnamese Army during the war in Southeast Asia, according to a statement from Congressman Jim Costa of California. Costa, advocating on behalf of Pao's family, requested the Army grant an exception to Arlington's regulations to permit Pao's burial in the nation's most revered cemetery. Pao recently died from complications related to pneumonia, according to Costa. The Army stated Friday evening: 'The Vang Pao family's request for an exception to the burial policy was thoroughly reviewed by a board of senior military and civilian officials. After a comprehensive analysis, the board unanimously recommended denying the request. The Secretary carefully reviewed and deliberated on this matter and accepted the board's recommendation.' According to the cemetery's policy, Pao was required to have served in the U.S. armed forces to be eligible for burial there. The family retains the option to appeal to the Defense Secretary and the President for an exception. A Pentagon spokesman stated that he was unaware whether any request regarding Pao's burial had reached the Defense Secretary as of Friday afternoon.

Generał major Vang Pao dowodził tysiącami żołnierzy Hmongów, walczących ramię w ramię ze Stanami Zjednoczonymi przeciwko Armii Północnowietnamskiej podczas wojny w Azji Południowo-Wschodniej, jak podaje kongresmen Jim Costa z Kalifornii. Costa, w imieniu rodziny Pao, poprosił armię o wyjątek od regulaminu Arlington, aby umożliwić pochówek Pao na tym ważnym dla narodu cmentarzu. Według relacji Costy, Pao zmarł niedawno z powodu powikłań po zapaleniu płuc. Po wnikliwej analizie, zespół jednogłośnie zarekomendował odrzucenie wniosku. Sekretarz dokładnie przeanalizował sprawę i przychylił się do rekomendacji zespołu.' Zgodnie z zasadami cmentarza, Pao musiałby służyć w amerykańskich siłach zbrojnych, aby móc zostać tam pochowanym. article_content: By Gerard Couzens. An 18-year-old has died after falling from the 'Inferno' rollercoaster at Terra Mitica, a theme park in Benidorm. The teenager, who was from Iceland, is believed to have been thrown from the ride due to a harness malfunction. He sustained severe injuries, including multiple fractures and head wounds. The accident occurred while he was on holiday with his father, brother, and a friend. Spanish police have confirmed the teenager's Icelandic nationality. Initial reports had incorrectly stated he was British. The 'Inferno' rollercoaster, whose name means 'Hell' in Catalan, features 360-degree turns and generates forces of 3g at speeds exceeding 40mph. A judicial source confirmed that a court in Benidorm has launched an investigation into the incident. The judge is awaiting a police report to determine the next course of action. Further information is currently unavailable. The incident took place around 4:30 PM. He was alive when paramedics arrived but died in the ambulance around 5:30 PM after suffering cardiac arrest. Terra Mitica, which translates to 'Mythical Land,' opened in 2000. The 'Inferno' rollercoaster opened in July 2007 and is located in the park's Egypt zone. Terra Mitica has been operating independently since emerging from temporary receivership in 2006. No official statement has been released by the theme park.

Do wypadku doszło podczas wakacji z ojcem, bratem i przyjacielem. Hiszpańska policja potwierdziła, że nastolatek był Islandczykiem. Początkowo informowano błędnie, że był Brytyjczykiem. Rollercoaster 'Inferno', którego nazwa w języku katalońskim oznacza 'Piekło', wykonuje obroty o 360 stopni i generuje przeciążenia 3g przy prędkościach przekraczających 64 km/h. article_content: The future of the United Kingdom could be determined by residents of Scotland who weren't born there. As the Scottish independence referendum hangs in the balance, the opinions of the 500,000 foreign-born individuals living in Scotland may decide whether the 307-year-old Union remains intact or dissolves. Of Scotland's 5.2 million residents, approximately 370,000 were born in England and are eligible to participate in the vote. Naomi Stewart, originally from Devon and a resident of Scotland for a decade, supports independence, stating that her region of Lanarkshire is deprived and in need of revitalization. She believes Scotland should be governed by a compassionate administration. Anya O’Shea, born in London and now living in Scotland after attending university in Edinburgh, is campaigning against independence, citing the uncertainties and risks involved. She feels it is unfair to expect working families to make a blind leap into the unknown. The referendum includes roughly 4 million eligible voters. Besides those born in England, around 120,800 citizens from other EU countries (excluding Welsh and Irish individuals) are also eligible, with significant numbers from Poland (33,000) and Germany (13,400). Other represented nationalities include French (4,300), Italians (3,600), Spaniards (3,000), Latvians (2,700) and Lithuanians (2,600). Experts suggest that many EU citizens may lean towards supporting independence due to a perception of hostility from Westminster towards Europe. Stefan Buettner, a Bavarian energy advisor residing in Edinburgh, feels Scotland is more pro-European and identifies cultural compatibility between Germans and Scots. However, Ildiko Mair, a Hungarian who moved to Aberdeen 23 years ago, notes that the Hungarian community largely opposes independence. She questions the rationale for disrupting a long-standing union.

article_content: The recent spell of sunshine Britain enjoyed has ended abruptly this weekend. The Met Office's warning for heavy rain and thunderstorms became a reality for spectators at London's Olympic Park. After weeks of sun, the audience at the Sainsbury's Anniversary Games sought cover and bought rain gear to protect themselves from the heavy showers. Weather experts warn some regions may experience localized flooding from this evening into Sunday as holidaymakers prepare for summer trips. Spectators at London's Olympic stadium were caught in heavy showers while watching athletes compete. Heavy showers are expected in some parts of the country for the first time in weeks. Spectators at the Olympic Park were prepared for the change in weather. Despite the bad weather, spectators enjoyed the event. Crowds at the Olympic Park in East London waited for the rain to stop. Festival attendees at WOMAD in Wiltshire experienced a soggy event. Visitors to Brighton enjoyed the last of the heatwave before the predicted storms. Rain and thunderstorms are expected this weekend, though some still enjoyed the warm weather in Brighton. Heavy rain and thunderstorms are expected in parts of the country, the Met Office warned, similar to showers in Glasgow earlier this week. The Met Office issued a 'yellow' warning due to concerns that showers and thunderstorms over France might affect south-east England and East Anglia. The thundery weather is expected to move north, covering large parts of England on Sunday, with up to 30mm of rain per hour in South East areas. Sean Penston of MeteoGroup said there was a high chance of flash flooding in areas affected by the rain. 'A pool of warm air is moving from the continent, arriving in south-east England by afternoon,' he said. 'This will bring heavy rain across much of south-east England before moving north-west across the Midlands, east Wales, and south-west England.' 'This rain will continue north into northern England and Scotland on Sunday. Further showers and thunderstorms will affect south-west England and Wales.' Crowds gathered at the 25th International Sunderland Airshow during the UK heatwave. RAF Red Arrows performed at the airshow. Parts of the country experienced flash flooding earlier in the week due to heavy rain. The South East will bear the brunt of the rain, with up to 30mm expected per hour and 50mm within three hours, according to the Met Office. This is comparable to the average rainfall of 80mm for July, MeteoGroup said. The Met Office warned of localized travel disruption due to surface water flooding and lightning strikes. The hot weather has impacted slugs. Temperatures will remain warm, between 23C and 25C for much of England, Mr Penston said. Gardeners have seen their lawns turn brown, but the dry weather has reduced slugs and snails. Last summer's wet weather increased slug populations, including the Spanish 'super' slug. The longest spell of warm weather since 2006 has reduced fears of a similar invasion this year. Mosquito numbers have also declined due to the dry weather. Weeks of blue skies and high temperatures are ending with heavy rain and thunderstorms expected. Met Office forecaster Sarah Holland said: 'It's going to be very wet over the weekend for some, with a warning for the South East and Cambridgeshire as thunderstorms and heavy rain move north from France.' July's hot spell is ending with temperatures dropping. Lightning struck the Eiffel Tower in Paris during a major storm. The rain will benefit gardens and summer berries. More drought-resistant plants have been helped by the hot weather, and the rain will help swell the berries. There is potential for a good apple and plum harvest. Mr. Oates highlighted the impact of the heat on slugs and noted the boom in nature after the warm spell. 'Much of Britain's nature is thriving after the warm spell, and many beneficial species are flourishing. Unpopular creatures like slugs, snails and biting flies are declining.' 'With abundant insects, birds such as swallows are thriving.' The July heatwave was the longest in seven years, with temperatures exceeding 28C (82f) somewhere in the UK for 19 days. The warmest day since July 2006 was recorded last Monday at Heathrow and Northolt, reaching 33.5C (92f). The Met Office's Lindsay Mears said: 'The best of the summer weather is over, and the next few days will be unsettled with thundery storms.' 'Temperatures will remain above average, but it will be humid with a risk of wet weather.'

Prognozująca z Met Office, Sarah Holland, powiedziała: „Dla niektórych weekend będzie bardzo mokry, dlatego wydano ostrzeżenie dla południowo-wschodniej Anglii i Cambridgeshire, ponieważ burze i ulewne deszcze przemieszczają się na północ znad Francji”. Rośliny bardziej odporne na suszę skorzystały z upałów, a deszcz pomoże jagodom zwiększyć objętość. Istnieje potencjał na dobre zbiory jabłek i śliwek. Pan Oates zwrócił uwagę na wpływ upałów na populację ślimaków i zauważył ożywienie przyrody po fali upałów. „Większość brytyjskiej przyrody odradza się po fali upałów, a wiele pożytecznych gatunków dobrze się rozwija. Niepopularne stworzenia, takie jak ślimaki i gryzące muchy, tracą na znaczeniu”. „Dzięki dużej liczbie owadów ptaki, takie jak jaskółki, mają doskonałe warunki do życia”. article_content: By David Gardner and Mike Jaccarino. Published: 18:13 EST, January 11, 2013 | Updated: 18:19 EST, January 11, 2013. Hollywood power brokers pledged a ‘dialogue’ with the Obama administration regarding depictions of gun violence in American cinema, following a high-profile White House meeting with Vice President Joe Biden. Entertainment industry leaders convened for two and a half hours on Thursday with Biden and other Obama administration officials to discuss potential solutions to the recent surge of gun violence in America. Finding solutions: Joe Biden speaks at a meeting with video game industry executives in Washington, D.C. Although no significant agreements were reached, the two sides agreed to collaborate more closely on the issue. ‘The entertainment community appreciates being included in the dialogue around the administration’s efforts to confront the complex challenge of gun violence in America,’ stated a joint statement issued after the meeting by, among other groups, the Directors Guild of America. ‘This industry has a long-standing commitment to provide parents with the tools necessary to make informed viewing decisions for their families.’ Meanwhile, Biden followed his summit with Hollywood moguls with a similar gathering on Friday with video game manufacturers. All the president's men: The president appointed Biden to head a task force to investigate ways to reduce gun violence in America. Fact-finding: Biden conducted a series of meetings this week with movie and video game industry representatives, as well as the NRA. Beating the bushes: Biden also met with advocates for sportsmen and wildlife interest groups in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in Washington, D.C., earlier in the week. Important mission: Biden talks to the press after a meeting with Cabinet members and sportsmen's, wildlife, and gun interest groups at the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in Washington, D.C., this week. Representatives from companies that produce 'first-person shooter' games such as 'Call of Duty,' 'Medal of Honor,' and 'Grand Theft Auto' attended the meeting, where the Vice President raised the possibility of using existing technology to ensure that only the weapon's purchaser can fire it. President Obama has prioritized gun control on his domestic agenda following last month’s school shooting. His administration is developing proposals that would include a ban on the sale of assault weapons, limits on high-capacity ammunition magazines, stricter regulations at gun fairs, and universal background checks for gun buyers. Few analysts expect Hollywood to make any sweeping attempts to curb violence in films. Change in the air: Obama formed the Biden-led task force following last month's shooting massacre at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut. Due date: Biden's task force is expected to provide recommendations for Obama on the issue as early as Tuesday. Hard stance: NRA president David Keene (pictured) said this week following a meeting with the Biden-led task force that he did not foresee an assault weapon ban passing Congress. But Mr. Biden, who is leading a White House task force putting together the new legislation, secured a pledge from film and television industry groups that they would collaborate more closely with Washington. America’s top gun lobby, the National Rifle Association, also met with the Vice President and stated they will attempt to block any new gun laws. Instead of making it more difficult for Americans to own guns, the group advocates for posting an armed security officer in every school in the country. ‘I do not think that there's going to be a ban on so-called assault weapons passed by the Congress,’ NRA president David Keene said after the meeting. The gun debate dominated the news in the US as details emerged about another school shooting that occurred in Taft, California, on Thursday morning. A 16-year-old student armed with a shotgun shot a teenager he claimed was bullying him and fired bullets at his terrified classmates. The confrontation could have been even worse but for a heroic teacher, Ryan Heber, who calmly told the teen to put the weapon down and surrender. His brave action provided enough of a distraction to allow 28 students to escape their classroom at Taft Union High School near Bakersfield, police said yesterday. The victim, who was hit in the shoulder, was in critical but stable condition yesterday and was expected to survive.

article_content: Thinking of updating your summer wardrobe? You might be surprised to find stylish and affordable options at your local Sainsbury's, Tesco, or Asda. Eliza Scarborough suggests skipping the usual high street stores this year. Sainsbury's has been investing in its Tu range, even doubling its design team last year. Now, their clothing rivals high street options. Consider their fresh, floral dress, perfect for summer weddings. Tesco's F&F range boasts a wide variety of shoes, with over 350 styles online. These shoes are comfortable and often feature padded soles. Look for their own brands and others like Dunlop and Dolcis. Asda is known for creating catwalk-inspired designs. Their drop-waist dress, reminiscent of Victoria Beckham's, is available for a fraction of the price and is easier to wear. Before hitting Hobbs or Jigsaw for office attire, check out Asda's unbelievably cheap workwear line. Their crisp white shirt and tapered trousers are great options. Also, consider their white summer cover-up coat. For knitwear, F&F at Tesco is a great alternative to John Lewis or M&S. They stock cashmere year-round. Their coral V-neck cashmere jumper is fantastic value and machine washable. F&F is inclusive, with tall, plus-size, and petite ranges. Their key pieces, like the monochrome tea dress, are available in all sizes. Petite dresses have higher waistbands, while curvy options have a more generous cut. Looking for figure-flattering clothing? Sainsbury's offers designs with a sharp, tailored look. Their dresses have built-in control slips to smooth the stomach and streamline thighs. And don't miss their popular skinny jeans. For everyday underwear, Asda provides affordable and feminine options. Their lingerie features lace edges and detailing. Their T-shirt bra is a bestseller, and their pleated chiffon briefs are similar to designer styles.

article_content: Voldemort's demise wasn't in vain. While Ralph Fiennes dedicated years to portraying Harry Potter's tormentor, he also managed to direct his first film. 'Coriolanus' is an ambitious project: a contemporary take on one of Shakespeare's more substantial, though less frequently staged, plays. Although not every aspect fully succeeds, Fiennes's courageous and energetic film will leave you pleased with his undertaking. Set in a location described as 'Some place calling itself Rome' but filmed in war-torn Serbia and Montenegro, 'Coriolanus' envisions a modern nation grappling with food shortages and border conflicts. General Caius Martius (Fiennes) returns in triumph after defeating his nemesis, Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler), and the Volsces at their fortress, Corioles, adopting the name of this significant victory. However, the proposition to appoint him consul, or head of state, worries certain senators who recognize his disdain for ordinary citizens. Though he easily wins over the Senate, custom dictates that Caius, now known as 'Coriolanus', must also secure the approval of the citizenry in the public square. Too proud to engage in popularity contests, he merely goes through the motions. When his adversaries incite the crowd against him, his rage only exacerbates the situation, and the general is exiled from Rome. Isolated and enraged, he vows revenge and offers his services to Aufidius. As with other modern Shakespeare adaptations, this production contains inconsistencies and peculiarities, featuring guns and tanks alongside references to swords and, ultimately, reverting to knife fights. The concept of a lone warrior-hero carrying battles single-handedly doesn't quite align with modern warfare, and it has been some time since a military figure held the presidency. Shakespeare's play clearly illustrates that valor on the battlefield, however esteemed, does not qualify one for political success. Coriolanus is undone by his unique integrity—a refusal to leverage his war record for votes—solely because he views the democratic process as degrading; he's a true elitist who believes in inherent privilege. In power, he would be disastrous. The manipulative, cynical politicians fare no better in this interpretation, nor does the inconstant and easily swayed populace. Politics is a dirty game, yet Coriolanus betrays everyone he knows to defend his distorted sense of honor. With a shaved head, scars, and often covered in blood, Fiennes delivers a captivating performance, reminiscent of a Roman Rambo. We know he excels at playing villains, but even as a quintessential fascist, Coriolanus possesses a certain nobility and a tragic flaw: his inability to compromise. He is his own man, yet we clearly see he is entirely shaped by his formidable mother, Volumnia (a magnificent Vanessa Redgrave), and ultimately powerless before her. Significantly condensed by screenwriter and playwright John Logan (whose scripts for 'Rango' and 'Hugo' also reached the screen last year), Shakespeare's verse sounds somewhat jarring in the mouths of cable TV newscasters. However, this technique effectively conveys background information and maintains the pace of the action. Logan has halved the play, but the movie compensates for any lost detail with enhanced clarity and impact. Budgetary restrictions likely explain Rome's surprisingly small population and the Volsci army, which appears to number only two dozen. Nevertheless, the talent in the foreground—Brian Cox, Jessica Chastain, and Gerard Butler—delivers impeccable performances. This is Shakespearean acting at its finest, offering a potent and bloody portrayal of 'honor' gone awry.
translated_content: Śmierć Voldemorta nie poszła na marne. Choć Ralph Fiennes poświęcił lata na portretowanie dręczyciela Harry'ego Pottera, zdołał również wyreżyserować swój pierwszy film. 'Koriolan' to ambitny projekt: współczesna interpretacja jednej z bardziej znaczących, choć rzadziej wystawianych sztuk Szekspira. Mimo że nie każdy aspekt w pełni się udaje, odważny i energiczny film Fiennesa sprawi, że widz będzie zadowolony z tego, jak się tego podjął. Akcja filmu rozgrywa się w miejscu określanym jako 'Jakieś miejsce zwane Rzymem', ale został nakręcony w ogarniętej wojną Serbii i Czarnogórze. 'Koriolan' przedstawia współczesny naród zmagający się z niedoborami żywności i konfliktami granicznymi. Generał Gajusz Marcjusz (Fiennes) wraca triumfalnie po pokonaniu swojego nemezis, Tulla Aufidiusa (Gerard Butler) i Wolsków w ich twierdzy, Korioles, przyjmując nazwę tego znaczącego zwycięstwa. Jednak propozycja mianowania go konsulem, czyli głową państwa, niepokoi niektórych senatorów, którzy rozpoznają jego pogardę dla zwykłych obywateli. Choć z łatwością zdobywa poparcie Senatu, zwyczaj nakazuje, aby Gajusz, teraz znany jako 'Koriolan', uzyskał również aprobatę obywateli na rynku publicznym. Zbyt dumny, by angażować się w konkursy popularności, po prostu wykonuje swoje obowiązki. Kiedy jego przeciwnicy podburzają tłum przeciwko niemu, jego wściekłość tylko pogarsza sytuację, a generał zostaje wygnany z Rzymu. Odizolowany i wściekły, poprzysięga zemstę i oferuje swoje usługi Aufidiusowi. Podobnie jak w innych współczesnych adaptacjach Szekspira, ta produkcja zawiera nieścisłości i osobliwości, prezentując broń i czołgi obok odniesień do mieczy i ostatecznie powracając do walk na noże. Koncepcja samotnego wojownika-bohatera, który sam wygrywa bitwy, nie do końca pasuje do realiów współczesnej wojny, a minęło trochę czasu, odkąd wojskowy sprawował urząd prezydenta. Sztuka Szekspira jasno pokazuje, że męstwo na polu bitwy, jakkolwiek cenione, nie jest wystarczającą kwalifikacją do sukcesu politycznego. Koriolana gubi jego specyficzna uczciwość - odmowa wykorzystania swojej przeszłości wojennej do zdobycia głosów - tylko dlatego, że uważa proces demokratyczny za poniżający; jest prawdziwym elitystą, który wierzy w przywileje wynikające z urodzenia. U władzy byłby katastrofą. Manipulacyjni, cyniczni politycy nie wypadają lepiej w tej interpretacji, podobnie jak niestałe i łatwo ulegające wpływom społeczeństwo. Polityka to brudna gra, a jednak Koriolan zdradza wszystkich, których zna, aby bronić swojego wypaczonego poczucia honoru. Z ogoloną głową, bliznami i często pokryty krwią, Fiennes daje porywający występ, przypominający rzymskiego Rambo. Wiemy, że doskonale gra czarne charaktery, ale nawet jako kwintesencja faszysty, Koriolan ma w sobie pewną szlachetność i tragiczną wadę: niezdolność do kompromisu. Jest panem samego siebie, ale wyraźnie widzimy, że jest całkowicie ukształtowany przez swoją potężną matkę, Wolumnię (wspaniała Vanessa Redgrave), i ostatecznie wobec niej bezsilny. Znacząco skrócony przez scenarzystę i dramaturga Johna Logana (którego scenariusze do 'Rango' i 'Hugo' również trafiły na ekrany w zeszłym roku), wiersz Szekspira brzmi nieco dziwnie w ustach prezenterów telewizji kablowej. Jednak ta technika skutecznie przekazuje informacje o tle wydarzeń i utrzymuje tempo akcji. Logan skrócił sztukę o połowę, ale film rekompensuje wszelkie utracone szczegóły zwiększoną klarownością i mocą przekazu. Ograniczenia budżetowe prawdopodobnie tłumaczą zaskakująco małą populację Rzymu i armię Wolsków, która wydaje się liczyć zaledwie kilkadziesiąt osób. Niemniej jednak talent na pierwszym planie - Brian Cox, Jessica Chastain i Gerard Butler - zapewnia bezbłędne występy. To szekspirowskie aktorstwo w najlepszym wydaniu, oferujące mocny i krwawy obraz 'honoru', który zszedł na manowce.

article_content: Stephanie Wilby, a mother, shared her experience of being asked to stop breastfeeding her baby at a public swimming pool. Wilby felt embarrassed when pool employees threatened to remove her if she continued, asserting her right to breastfeed anywhere she chooses. The 22-year-old was waist-deep in the toddler pool, feeding her four-month-old son, Leo, while other families were present. According to Wilby, a lifeguard approached swiftly and demanded she stop, claiming it was similar to someone urinating in the pool and 'indecent exposure'. Wilby, accompanied by her husband Alan and 17-month-old daughter Harmonie, questioned the reasoning, but was told it was unhygienic. When she requested to speak with a manager, the manager supported the lifeguard and threatened to call security if she didn't comply. Manchester Council has launched an investigation into the incident at the Aquatics Centre, managed by Serco and the Manchester Sport and Leisure Trust. Opinions on whether Wilby should have breastfed in the pool varied widely across social media. Another mother, Tara Powell, faced a similar situation at a Jobcentre in Bromley, where she was told to stop breastfeeding her son. The Mail Online reported that Powell was reduced to tears after being allegedly kicked out of the Jobcentre for breastfeeding. The Department for Work and Pensions apologized to Powell for the incident and stated that mothers are welcome to breastfeed in their facilities. The campaign group 'We Do It In Public' highlighted that negative perceptions of breastfeeding in public persist and cause issues for mothers. Wilby stated that she was surrounded by employees threatening removal and was told breastfeeding in the pool was like a swimmer urinating in the water. Officials at the Manchester Aquatics Centre apologized for the event. Wilby, who is on maternity leave, stated she should have the freedom to breastfeed wherever legally allowed and tactfully done, without harassment. She further mentioned the staff could not justify the request with any specific law or rule. Councillor Rosa Battle emphasized that Manchester Council supports mothers using leisure facilities and breastfeeding their babies, in accordance with existing laws. Serco also stated their support for breastfeeding in a safe environment but prefer it not to occur in the swimming pool.

article_content: Beyoncé's 'Renaissance: A Film By Beyoncé,' capturing her worldwide tour, is set to debut in Los Angeles on November 25 and in London on November 30. It will then arrive in cinemas globally on December 1. Tickets will be up for grabs starting November 9 in numerous international areas, including Africa, Asia, Australia, Europe, South America, and the Caribbean, according to announcements from Parkwood Entertainment and AMC Entertainment, the distributor. North American tickets are already available. The film will be screened from Thursdays to Sundays, with various showtimes scheduled throughout the day. Standard ticket prices in North America will begin at $22 plus tax, with similar pricing expected internationally. The 'Renaissance' world tour, which the film documents, included 56 performances across 39 cities in 12 countries, starting in Stockholm and concluding in Kansas City. Following the success of 'Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour,' AMC is tapping into the popularity of concert films with this new release, a welcome addition to a box office affected by the ongoing actors' strike. To date, 'Eras Tour' has earned $179 million worldwide, with $132 million from domestic sales, since its premiere earlier this month. AMC is partnering with Parkwood, Beyoncé’s production company and record label, to release 'Renaissance.' Similar to the approach with 'Eras Tour,' AMC plans to screen 'Renaissance' on weekends for at least a month. Variance, a NYC-based distributor, is managing cinema bookings for AMC in the US. Cineplex is handling Canada, Cinepolis is managing Central America, and Trafalgar Releasing is overseeing distribution outside North America. According to Beyoncé's website, 'Renaissance: A Film By Beyoncé' highlights the 'Renaissance' world tour's journey from its initial concept and Stockholm premiere to the finale in Kansas City. It explores Beyoncé’s dedication, hard work, and creative vision, aiming to build her legacy and perfect her craft. The tour received widespread acclaim, creating a 'sanctuary for freedom' and sharing joy with over 2.7 million fans.

article_content: Two 160-million-year-old fossils discovered in China represent the earliest known tree-dwelling and subterranean mammals. Agilodocodon scansorius, with claws suited for climbing and teeth adapted for a tree sap diet, is the earliest known tree-dwelling mammaliaform (an extinct relative of modern mammals). Docofossor brachydactylus, the earliest known subterranean mammaliaform, features adaptations similar to African golden moles, such as shovel-like paws. Early mammals are believed to have emerged approximately 200 million years ago during the Mesozoic Era, coexisting with dinosaurs and pterosaurs. The earliest known bird appeared around 150 million years ago. Agilodocodon scansorius, an omnivore that lived about 165 million years ago, had curved claws for climbing, limb dimensions typical of tree-dwelling mammals, and flexible joints for agile movement in trees. Its spade-like front teeth were suited for chewing bark and consuming tree gum or sap. Docofossor, a mole-like insect-eater from approximately 160 million years ago, possessed shovel-like paws for digging, teeth resembling those of later burrowing mammals, and sprawling limbs for underground locomotion. University of Chicago paleontologist Zhe-Xi Luo described Docofossor as a 'dead ringer' for modern African golden moles. Similarities in finger traits between Docofossor and golden moles suggest a possible shared genetic basis, despite their distant relationship and separation by 160 million years. Discoveries in recent years have challenged the notion that Mesozoic mammals had limited diversification, revealing various specializations including swimming, tree-living, and digging. According to Luo, early mammalian relatives explored ecological niches as diverse and interesting as those of modern mammal groups. Both Agilodocodon and Docofossor belonged to the docodonts, an extinct order of early mammals. Castorocauda, another docodont from the same period, exhibited beaver-like traits for an aquatic lifestyle. The newly discovered fossils demonstrate diverse feeding and locomotor functions in stem mammaliaforms, indicating a broader ecological range during the Mesozoic Era, despite dinosaur dominance.

Docofossor brachydactylus, najstarszy znany ssak podziemny, posiada adaptacje zbliżone do tych u afrykańskich złotokretów, takie jak łopatkowate łapy. Uważa się, że pierwsze ssaki pojawiły się około 200 milionów lat temu, w erze mezozoicznej, współistniejąc z dinozaurami i pterozaurami. Najstarszy znany ptak pojawił się około 150 milionów lat temu. Agilodocodon scansorius, wszystkożerny ssak żyjący około 165 milionów lat temu, miał zakrzywione pazury umożliwiające wspinaczkę, proporcje kończyn charakterystyczne dla ssaków nadrzewnych oraz elastyczne stawy, które ułatwiały zwinne poruszanie się po drzewach. Jego przednie zęby przypominające dłuto były przystosowane do zdrapywania kory i spożywania soków lub żywicy z drzew. Docofossor, owadożerny ssak przypominający kreta, żyjący około 160 milionów lat temu, charakteryzował się łopatkowatymi łapami do kopania, uzębieniem podobnym do tego u późniejszych ssaków ryjących, żerujących pod ziemią, oraz szeroko rozstawionymi kończynami idealnymi do poruszania się pod ziemią. Paleontolog Zhe-Xi Luo z Uniwersytetu w Chicago określił Docofossora mianem 'żywego sobowtóra' współczesnych afrykańskich złotokretów. Podobieństwo cech palców Docofossora i złotokretów sugeruje możliwe wspólne podłoże genetyczne, pomimo ich odległego pokrewieństwa i 160 milionów lat ewolucji w izolacji. Odkrycia z ostatnich lat podważyły tezę, że ssaki mezozoiczne cechowały się ograniczoną dywersyfikacją, ujawniając różnorodne adaptacje, w tym zdolność do pływania, życia na drzewach i kopania. Zdaniem Luo, wczesne ssaki z naszej linii rodowodowej eksplorowały nisze ekologiczne równie zróżnicowane i interesujące, co współczesne grupy ssaków. Zarówno Agilodocodon, jak i Docofossor należały do dokodontów, wymarłego rzędu wczesnych ssaków. Castorocauda, kolejny dokodont żyjący w tym samym okresie, wykazywał cechy bobra, przystosowane do wodnego trybu życia. Nowo odkryte skamieniałości świadczą o różnorodnych funkcjach odżywiania i lokomocji u pierwotnych ssaków, co wskazuje na szerszy zakres ekologiczny w erze mezozoicznej, mimo dominacji dinozaurów.

article_content: An 8-year-old boy from Cincinnati was fatally shot in the chest on Saturday after one of his brothers played with a loaded handgun, which he mistakenly believed was a BB gun, according to police reports. Cincinnati Police Lt. Don Luck informed the Cincinnati Enquirer that the three brothers were visiting their uncle in the Price Hill neighborhood when they discovered the loaded gun. One of them pulled the trigger, hitting Sammy Lorenzo in the chest. Sammy was immediately taken to Cincinnati Children's Hospital for emergency surgery but unfortunately died. The shooting took place at the boy's uncle's residence in Cincinnati's Price Hill neighborhood. According to Luck, one of the brothers 'kept recounting the event repeatedly,' expressing the profound sadness of the situation. 'It's so sad.' Luck stated that no charges are anticipated against the children involved. He added that it is still too early to determine if any adults will face charges. An adult was present in the house at the time, but not in the same room where the shooting occurred, police confirmed. Sgt. Jim Perkins told WLWT, 'Everyone is understandably distraught given the circumstances. We are currently investigating the whereabouts of the adult inside the house at the time of the incident.' Cincinnati homicide detectives have investigated the case and concluded that the shooting was accidental. The name of Sammy's brother has not been disclosed. The Mail Online attempted to contact the Cincinnati Police Department for additional details about the case but received no comment. The boy was shot by his brother, who was handling a handgun and mistook it for a toy.

article_content: The casting of James Barbour in the Broadway production of 'The Phantom Of The Opera' has ignited controversy due to his prior conviction for child sex offenses. The show announced this week that Barbour, aged 48, will assume the role of the Phantom in New York starting in February. This announcement has drawn considerable criticism, with many deeming it inappropriate for the long-running musical to employ someone with a past involving sex offenses against a teenage girl 14 years ago. James Barbour was indicted in 2006 on nine counts, including engaging in criminal sexual acts, sexual abuse, and endangering the welfare of a child. In 2008, Barbour pleaded guilty to two misdemeanors related to an incident in 2001 involving a 15-year-old. He received a sentence of 60 days in jail and three years' probation. Following his sentence, Barbour returned to Broadway in September 2008, starring in 'A Tale Of Two Cities'. He earned nominations for the Drama Desk, Drama League, and Outer Critics Awards for Best Actor for his performance. Barbour is married to actress Dana Stackpole, also 48, who previously starred in the musical. After the announcement of his casting, 'Phantom' fans voiced their outrage. Kayla Fender posted on the show's Facebook page, stating, 'It is highly inappropriate to cast a convicted child molester as the Phantom, especially given the young fan base and the young actresses playing Christine. I will not support this show with him in the role.' Producers released a statement on the show's Facebook page on Wednesday, asserting that Barbour had taken responsibility for his actions and 'honored the second chance he was given'. The statement continued, 'Following his sentence in 2008, James resumed his career, starring in A TALE OF TWO CITIES on Broadway.' 'In the seven years since then, he has appeared in numerous productions in New York and across the country, receiving significant acclaim and maintaining a spotless reputation. Additionally, he has been an active member of the Broadway community, dedicating his time to various charitable causes.' According to 'The Phantom Of The Opera' fan site, Andrew Lloyd Webber's production is the longest-running in Broadway history, with over 10,000 performances in 25 years. Barbour will take over the role of the Phantom in February.

article_content: Despite being available for only a few weeks, there are online whispers that Apple is already gearing up to produce the iPhone 5's successor, supposedly named the iPhone 5S. According to a report from a Chinese website, Apple is planning to commence trial production of this new model as early as next month. However, the site doesn't provide any specifics regarding potential new features. The Commercial Times predicts that full-scale commercial production of the speculated iPhone 5S will begin in the first quarter of 2013. The initial December run is anticipated to yield only between 50,000 and 100,000 units. While Apple's iPhone 5 was launched on September 29th, recent reports suggest that a new iteration might enter production within a month and be available for purchase next year. DigiTimes cites a paper stating that Apple is expediting the certification of components for the iPhone 5S due to encountering low production yield rates with the iPhone 5. The paper also suggests that while the rumored iPhone 5S is projected to go into mass production in the first quarter of 2013, Apple is also likely to introduce a new iPad version a quarter later than the iPhone 5S, because the display resolution of the latest iPad version was lower than anticipated. Although trial production might be on the horizon, some individuals believe the iPhone 5S's actual release might be delayed until later in the year. Luke Peters, editor of T3 magazine, commented, 'The industry was taken aback by the speed at which the iPad 4 replaced the 3, but that move was aimed at standardizing the connector across all of Apple's high-end products.' He added, 'While trial production might give us glimpses online, a launch typically follows 6-7 months later. Therefore, I anticipate seeing a new iPhone version, whether it's an iPhone 5S or a 6, towards the end of next year.' This news emerges as Samsung's Galaxy S3 has become the world's top-selling smartphone model for the recent quarter, surpassing Apple's iPhone. Strategy Analytics reports that Apple had dominated this ranking for over two years. The firm claims that Samsung sold 18 million Galaxy S3 units in the third quarter, while Apple's iPhone 4S sales reached 16.2 million. Strong sales of the flagship Galaxy S3, which features a large 4.8-inch touchscreen, helped Samsung achieve a record operating profit of $7.3 billion in the July-September quarter. It is believed that Apple customers were also anticipating the iPhone 5 release, which is expected to restore Apple to its leading position.
